WITH telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse
  FROM telescope_avgs ta
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
  WHERE ta.avg_pulse > oa.overall_avg
),
second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_avg
  FROM above_overall
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT ao.telescref, ao.avg_pulse
  FROM above_overall ao
  CROSS JOIN second_avg sa
  WHERE ao.avg_pulse > sa.second_avg
)
SELECT
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse,
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse) - oa.overall_avg as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(ft.avg_pulse) - sa.second_avg as avg_above_second
FROM final_telescopes ft
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
CROSS JOIN second_avg sa

alternatives.interpretation: If 'overall average pulse rate' refers to the simple average of telescope-level averages (before filtering) rather than the average of all individual pulsepersec values across signals, then overall_avg computes AVG(avg_pulse) from telescope_avgs instead of AVG(pulsepersec) from signals. Results differ only when telescopes have unequal observation counts.
